entities.name: Zuzana Števulová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zuzana Števulová is a Slovak politician, lawyer, lecturer and migrants' rights activist. She was the first Slovak to be given an International Women of Courage Award. In 2023 she was elected as an MP of the National Council of Slovakia.
